repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period with a threshold of 45, causing the action to fire after 45 seconds (45 ticks). The IR requires a 45-second sustain window, which corresponds to 450 ticks at a 100 ms grid. The action must wait until the 451st tick to ensure the full 45 seconds have elapsed.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 100 to match the fine-grained sustain requirement. Updated the threshold from 45 to 451 (450 ticks + 1) so the action fires exactly after 45 seconds of continuous condition satisfaction.
